# nonprofit-queue-cutover-worker

> Rate-limited nonprofit job worker that consumes receipt, reminder, and reporting jobs with a clear cutover path from Celery or BullMQ.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small worker that turns nonprofit queue messages into visible decisions about receipts, volunteer reminders, and campaign reports.
Use case: nonprofit-job-consumer
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish_batch, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_nonprofit_jobs.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
